title: I’m making a multiplayer RPG focused on shared AI-driven storytelling (all free)
author: fwackedbubbed
selftext:
Hi guys. I’m an indie developer, and over the past few months I’ve been building an AI RPG with a few friends helping with testing and design. 

I have been using ChatGPT to assist with coding and iteration while I handle the game design, system integration, testing, and debugging. The game currently uses Gemini for dialogue, character behavior, and world-state management. 

The game supports both solo play and small-group multiplayer. Players can create characters, enter the same story world, interact with AI-controlled characters, and take actions using their own words instead of choosing only from preset options.  
What interests me most is what happens when players try something unexpected.

For example, a player might attempt to deceive a guard, persuade an enemy to switch sides, create a distraction, or combine several small actions in a way we never explicitly planned. The game needs to respond while keeping the world, characters, and consequences consistent.

That is also the hardest part to build. Generating dialogue is relatively easy. Making characters remember important events, act according to their own motivations, and letting actions affect the story over time is much more difficult.

I’m experimenting with AI-generated character visuals, environments, and voices as well, but those are secondary. The main goal is to see whether AI can make cooperative storytelling more flexible and surprising, while still giving players meaningful decisions and a persistent world.

The project is still in the early stages of development. I’m looking for people who enjoy AI games, RPGs and interactive fiction to try the demo and tell me honestly where it feels like a game, and where it still feels like chatting with an AI.

Try here if you're interested (all Tokens are free right now): [https://fictor.com/](https://fictor.com/)
